main_text.l: S. Theologiæ in Academia Oxoniensi Professore Regio.
Præmissa Oratione ab eodem habita cum publicam professionem auspicaretur 26. Octobr. 1646.
Typis T. R. & E. M. Prostat venale apud O. Pullen & A. Crook, in Cœmeterio S. Pauli

page.notes: The manuscript shelf mark "Z.5.66" at upper right is handwriting and is not transcribed. Dark stains and the binding shadow at the left edge are not text. Some letters in the title are worn, notably in "Promissorii" and "Oxon."; the readings given follow the scan as far as legible.
